# Awesome Example

[![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://awesome.re) [![CI](https://github.com/example-org/awesome-example/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/example-org/awesome-example/actions)

A constructed list for the tests: every link shape the extractor has to handle.
Curated by [@octocat](https://github.com/octocat) and [the org](https://github.com/orgs/example-org/people).

## Tools

- [Hello World](https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World) - plain inline link.
- [Archived](https://github.com/octocat/archived-example/tree/main/src) - deeper path, tree.
- [Blob](https://github.com/octocat/unlicensed-example/blob/main/README.md#usage) - blob with a fragment.
- [Readme anchor](https://github.com/octocat/other-licence-example#readme) - fragment only.
- [Clone URL](https://github.com/octocat/renamed-example.git) - .git suffix.
- [Gone](https://github.com/octocat/gone-example) ![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/octocat/gone-example?style=social) - a shields.io badge.
- <https://github.com/TransformerOptimus/SuperAGI> - autolink.
- Bare URL https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp, followed by a comma.
- Bare URL at the end of a sentence: https://github.com/punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers.
- Without a scheme github.com/anthropics/skills in prose, and www: www.github.com/n8n-io/n8n
- <a href="https://github.com/punkpeye/awesome-mcp-clients?tab=readme-ov-file">HTML link</a>
- [Same repository, other case](https://github.com/OCTOCAT/hello-world) - deduplicated.
- [Reference style][ref] - the URL is in the definition at the bottom.
- 「日本語のツール」 [ツール](https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World/releases) — unicode around a link.
- [agent-vitals](https://github.com/Keremozdemirra/agent-vitals) - the one recorded live response.

## Not repositories

- Profile https://github.com/octocat and org https://github.com/example-org?tab=repositories
- Topic https://github.com/topics/mcp, gist https://gist.github.com/octocat/6cad326836d38bd3a7ae, sponsors https://github.com/sponsors/octocat
- Issue https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World/issues/42 and pull request https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/7
- Marketplace https://github.com/marketplace/actions/checkout and an app https://github.com/apps/dependabot
- Image ![logo](https://github.com/octocat/image-only/raw/main/logo.png) and <img src="https://github.com/octocat/html-image/raw/main/x.png" alt="">
- Raw https://raw.githubusercontent.com/octocat/raw-only/main/README.md and pages https://octocat.github.io/pages-only/
- Inline code `git clone https://github.com/octocat/inline-code-only` is not a link.
